subject.title: fix(feishu): DMs send a spurious no-visible-reply fallback after an intentional silent NO_REPLY

question: Should this PR wait for maintainer- or contributor-supplied redacted real Feishu DM evidence before the message-delivery change is merged?
rationale: The implementation and mocked pipeline tests are coherent, but only someone with an appropriate Feishu workspace can establish the required user-visible after-fix behavior.

options.title: Capture live Feishu proof
options.body: Record a redacted DM transcript, terminal trace, or runtime log showing NO_REPLY stays silent while a genuinely empty completion still emits the fallback, then refresh review.

options.title: Accept test-only proof
options.body: Merge based on the focused pipeline regressions and CI while explicitly accepting that no live Feishu delivery evidence was collected.

recommendation.title: Capture live Feishu proof
recommendation.body: Record a redacted DM transcript, terminal trace, or runtime log showing NO_REPLY stays silent while a genuinely empty completion still emits the fallback, then refresh review.
